scope: component-level backtest of the daily market possibility report
why_no_single_accuracy: The email has conditional branches. A range/break/reclaim scenario is not one unconditional UP/DOWN prediction, so each claim is scored separately.

daily_default.target: next trading-session close-to-close UP / FLAT / DOWN
daily_default.evidence: v2 is the currently emailed decoder; v3 is not the default because its close-to-close uplift is mostly overnight-gap behaviour.

daily_v3_research.target: next trading-session close-to-close UP / FLAT / DOWN
daily_v3_research.evidence: v2 is the currently emailed decoder; v3 is not the default because its close-to-close uplift is mostly overnight-gap behaviour.

weekly.evidence: This was the old v2 weekly candidate and failed its 2026 confirmation; the live report therefore displays weekly context/playbook, not a directional call.

levels.target: next-session range touches level then support holds / resistance rejects
levels.evidence: Daily-bar proxy only; it cannot establish candle order, sweep/reclaim, entry, stop, or slippage.

vix.target: next-session NIFTY absolute close-to-close move, not UP/DOWN direction
vix.evidence: Two thresholds were fitted only through 2024 then gated in development, 2025 validation, and 2026 confirmation. No VIX direction override was searched or adopted.

v10.target: at open, abs gap 0.03% to <0.12% → previous close touched intraday
v10.evidence: This is known only after the cash-market open and predicts a level touch, not all-day close direction or a profitable options trade.
